{"consolidated_memory":"## NaN Feature Issues in ml/features/encoder.py - Two Separate Incidents

Both incidents affected the same component (ml/features/encoder.py feature encoder) but had different triggers, root causes, and fixes.

### Incident 1: Corporate Proxy Traffic - Timezone Mismatch (2026-07-28)

**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through the corporate proxy

**Signal:** Not-a-number value in one output column

**Root Cause:** Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime (timezone mismatch)

**Fix:** Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge

**PR & Branch:** #2191 on branch fix/nan-feature-1

**Reproduction:** Encode the batch holding the sparse column

**Measured Outcome:** p99 latency fell from 1.3 s to 509 ms

---

### Incident 2: OAuth Provider Sessions - Unbounded Retry Loop (2026-07-29)

**Trigger:** Sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider

**Signal:** Not-a-number value in one output column

**Root Cause:** Unbounded retry loop with no backoff

**Fix:** Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter

**PR & Branch:** #2433 on branch fix/nan-feature-2

**Reproduction:** Encode the batch holding the sparse column

**Measured Outcome:** Flaky test went from 13 failures per hundred runs to zero

---

**Context:** Both incidents occurred in the same corner of ml/features/encoder.py as earlier NaN feature work, indicating this is a recurring problem area in the feature encoder pipeline."}
